name: WelfordFinalize
note: WelfordFinalize(outputMean<float>, outputVariance<float>, inputMean<float>, inputVariance<float>, sharedTmpBuffer, WelfordFinalizePara). Combines per-partition partial mean/var into final mean/var. Para: abLength=headCountLength+tailCountLength (32B aligned). Simplest path tailCountLength=0: outMean=abRec*sum(inputMean), outVar=rRec*sum(inputVariance+rnLength*(inputMean-outMean)^2). All means equal -> diff 0 -> outMean=mean, outVar=var. abRec=rRec=1/abLength. Outputs scalar at index 0.
